title: GAP_KWP_TO_ADAPTER_ENCAPSULATION
description: Continuous data flow from ECU diagnostic request (KWP service / measuring block) to Ross-Tech adapter send_frame is unresolved across vtable dispatch in BlockDlg.
required_evidence: Complete decompiled AST or dynamic bus trace bridging BlockDlg::OnGraph (0x14005911c) to vcds_adapter_send_frame (0x14007E734).

title: GAP_KEEPALIVE_ADAPTER_OPCODE
description: The specific opcode used by Ross-Tech adapter to maintain active K-Line/CAN session without sending diagnostic requests is unmapped.
required_evidence: Dynamic trace of idle session or static identification of session timer callback.
